name: Natural Beauty
desc: Looks +3. Buffed from the moment you spawned.

name: Genius Brain
desc: Intellect +3. Neuronal density off the charts.

name: Iron Bones
desc: Physique +3. Hospitals are foreign territory.

name: Silver Spoon
desc: Wealth +3. You start where others finish.

name: Optimist
desc: Happiness +2, Luck +0.1. If the sky falls, you will use it as a blanket.

name: Sensitive Soul
desc: Intellect +1, but trauma intensity ×1.5. The antenna that feels the world is also a wound.

name: Heart of Stone
desc: Trauma intensity ×0.6, Happiness -1. Nothing pierces you—and nothing moves you.

name: Born Healer
desc: Therapy effects ×2. Wherever you go, someone starts getting better.

name: Lucky One
desc: Luck +0.25. Every pull comes out gold.

name: Social Butterfly
desc: Looks +1, Happiness +1. Crowds are your home turf.

name: Exam Grinder
desc: Intellect +2. Drilling practice problems is the only ladder up.

name: Martial Prodigy
desc: Physique +3, Looks +1.

name: Sickly
desc: Physique -2, Intellect +2. The body is a prison for the mind.

name: Self-Made
desc: Wealth +1, Luck +0.15. With nothing to lose, you fear nothing.

name: Trauma Resilience
desc: Trauma intensity ×0.75. You have been broken—and you know how to grow back.

name: Empath
desc: Therapy effects ×1.5, Happiness +1. Other people's pain is real in your body.

name: Paranoia
desc: Intellect +1, trauma intensity ×1.3. A hairline separates genius from the abyss.

name: Performer's Persona
desc: Looks +2, Happiness +1. All of life is a stage.

name: The Practitioner
desc: Therapy effects ×1.2, Happiness +2. There is a house inside you that never collapses.

name: Star-Gazer
desc: Luck +0.1, Intellect +1. You believe fate follows rules.

name: Thick Skin
desc: Happiness +2, trauma intensity ×0.85. Obliviousness is a gift.

name: Ace Student
desc: Intellect +2, Physique +1. All-night cramming, still fresh the next day.

name: Child of Destiny
desc: Happiness +2, Luck +0.3, trauma intensity ×0.7. The world keeps hidden favors for you.

name: Koi Incarnate
desc: Luck +0.45. Everyone who reposted this talent regretted it later.

name: Unkillable Cockroach
desc: Physique +2, trauma intensity ×0.8. Fate keeps rolling over you; you keep getting up.

name: Time Management Master
desc: Intellect +2, Physique +1, Happiness +0.5. Someone who lives two days in every one.

name: Photographic Memory
desc: Intellect +3, Happiness -0.5. You remember everything—including what you should not.

name: Peerless Beauty
desc: Looks +4, Happiness -0.5. Beauty is a gift and the start of trouble.

name: King of the Stage
desc: Looks +3, Happiness +1. The spotlight follows you around.

name: Midas Touch
desc: Wealth +2, Luck +0.15. Whatever you touch rises in price.

name: Body of Steel
desc: Physique +4. Every line on your checkup report reads normal.

name: Soul Catcher
desc: Therapy effects ×2.5. Your hugs have clinical efficacy.

name: Chaos Walker
desc: Luck +0.2, trauma intensity ×1.2. Wild swings are how you breathe.

name: Business Nose
desc: Wealth +1, Intellect +1. You always stand on the right side of the wind.

name: Hexagon Warrior
desc: All stats +1. No weak sides—and no sharp ones either.

name: Steel Heart
desc: Trauma intensity ×0.5, Happiness -2. The volume of emotion turned down to the minimum.

name: Danger Instinct
desc: Luck +0.12, trauma intensity ×0.85. You frown three seconds before disaster strikes.

name: Well-Liked
desc: Looks +2, Happiness +1. Your contacts list is a ledger of connections.

name: Martial Family
desc: Physique +2, Looks +1. The family fist manual is older than you.

name: Scholarly Lineage
desc: Intellect +2, Wealth +1. The living room is a library, and the library is everything.

name: Late Bloomer
desc: Luck +0.08. The first half of life was all foreshadowing for the second.

name: Empathic Gift
desc: Therapy effects ×1.8, Happiness +0.5. Your ears can catch tears.

name: Social Anxiety
desc: Intellect +1, Looks -1. Crowds are high-voltage wires; solitude is the charger.

name: Foodie
desc: Happiness +2, Physique +0.5. Nothing a hot pot cannot fix.

name: Catlike Nature
desc: Happiness +1, Physique +0.5. Loves sleep, shy of strangers, deeply soothing.

name: Precocious
desc: Intellect +2, Happiness -1. Understanding too early is a burden.

name: Grind King
desc: Intellect +1.5, Physique -0.5. Resting fills you with guilt.

name: Lying-Flat Expert
desc: Happiness +1.5, Wealth -0.5. Wanting little is a survival wisdom.

name: Looks Anxiety
desc: Looks +1, Happiness -1. The mirror is an instrument of torture you pass every day.

name: Insomniac
desc: Intellect +0.5, Happiness -1.5. You know the 4 a.m. ceiling best.

name: Affluenza
desc: Wealth +2, Happiness -1. Wanting for nothing is, sometimes, the hardest feeling.

name: Child of the Jianghu
desc: Physique +1, Looks +1, Happiness +0.5. Loyalty is etched into your bones.

name: Bookworm
desc: Intellect +1.5, Physique -0.3. The world between pages is bigger than the one outside the window.

name: Athletic Instinct
desc: Physique +2. Body coordination maxed out.

name: Good Voice
desc: Looks +1, Happiness +0.5. The moment you open your mouth, the room goes quiet.

name: Handy
desc: Intellect +0.5, Wealth +0.5. A pair of restless hands that always conjure something up.

name: Honest Soul
desc: Happiness +0.5, Looks -0.5. Getting shortchanged is a blessing—the blessing is still on its way.

name: No Sense of Direction
desc: Happiness -0.3. The GPS says you have arrived—and you are standing by a pond.

name: Decision Paralysis
desc: Happiness -0.5. You stood for half an hour between two flavors.

name: Root of Wisdom
desc: Therapy effects ×1.6, Happiness +1. When the Buddha held up a flower, you happened to be there.

name: Immortal Affinity
desc: Luck +0.12. They say the temple lamps all lit the day you were born—your grandmother says so.

name: Silver Tongue
desc: Intellect +2, Looks +0.5. Your gift of gab can fool ghosts—and save lives.

name: Atheist
desc: Intellect +1, Happiness -0.5, trauma intensity ×0.9. No god to blame, and no god to fear.
